venue_elimination.waterfront_spindrift: Sushi, $$, hushed, full fish- and meat-free page, no fryer, peanut-safe. Meets everything.
venue_elimination.waterfront_starboard: Deal-breaker: peanuts in the house dressing over the veg page and in the spinach (Cyrus's allergy).
venue_elimination.waterfront_gull_point: Deal-breaker: nothing vegetarian (eel sauce, salmon in the cucumber roll).
venue_elimination.waterfront_mooring_post: $$$, one tier over budget (-1 star); otherwise fits.
venue_elimination.waterfront_ropewalk: Loud (bells, shouting, loud playlist), so it misses the quiet preference (-1 star).
venue_elimination.waterfront_halyard: Everything is fried (tempura, panko), so it misses Brooke's no-fryer wish (-1 star).
venue_elimination.waterfront_cormorant: Greek, not sushi, so it misses Cyrus's craving (-1 star).

notes: Fair and solvable. The peanut allergy is the most indirect clue: it is never stated outright, only implied by 'satay incident 2.0' and Mina 'reading the sauces' for Cyrus. A player who misses it could take Starboard, though its hushed room and veg page make it a good trap. Every decoy fails exactly one need, which makes a clean elimination grid. Spindrift's reviews hit all six needs very directly (the third review spells out peanut safety), so once the constraints are found the answer is obvious. Nothing contradictory.
